name: Ohinasama ~Shiawase wa Suigin no Aji~
original_name: オヒナサマ　~しあわせは水銀の味~
source:
The protagonist is a fatigued, out-of-work NEET dependent.
By chance he meets a young girl and inexplicable phenomena occur...
